description: Myanmar - Cities and Town Location with Population is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Demographics", published or maintained by Shaky Sherpa (Columbia University Earth Institute). Data collected and organized as input to the geospatial least-cost planning for universal electricity access by 2030 as part of the the project funded by the World Bank for Myanmar National Electrification Plan (NEP).The dataset list the locations and population of all cities and towns in Myanmar. Coverage: Myanmar. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, ZIP. The portal files it under Demographics. The portal gives 2014 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
